blocks.title: Etesian for the web.
blocks.lead: The design language is a Vue 3 component library, so anything on the web can look and work like Etesian.

blocks.title: This website
blocks.text: A working Etesian desktop and phone in the browser, built from the library's own components: drag, snap and resize windows, open Events, swipe through the phone.

blocks.title: Cloud Companion
blocks.text: A self-hosted server with an Etesian web app for mail, calendar, contacts and a browser, on any device, including old phones that can't handle the modern web.
